# TOOCAA Guides

Practical guides for laser projects, materials, setup and troubleshooting.

- [TOOCAA Learning Center](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/): Get started with your TOOCAA laser. Find setup tutorials, material settings, project ideas, and help for cutting and engraving with NOVA and L2.
- [Laser Cutting & Engraving Project Ideas](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/use-cases/): Explore seven laser project guides: craft studios, personalized gifts, QR code signs, home decor, jewelry, gift packaging, and photo engraving.
- [TOOCAA Laser Cutting & Engraving Tutorials](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/tutorials/): Follow practical TOOCAA tutorials for setup, focus, cutting, engraving, material testing, TOOCAA Studio, LightBurn, and rotary preparation.
- [Laser Materials Guide: Wood, Acrylic, Leather & More](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/learn/materials/): Choose wood, acrylic, leather, and other laser materials. Find L2 setting references, preparation steps, and tips for checking your finished work.
- [TOOCAA Support: Setup, Maintenance & Contact](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/support/): Get help with your TOOCAA laser: first setup, maintenance, troubleshooting, manuals, and contact details for the support team.
- [TOOCAA Troubleshooting: Cutting, Connection & Safety](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/troubleshooting/): Find symptom-based checks for TOOCAA laser output, incomplete cuts, engraving quality, movement, connection, smoke, safety alerts, and firmware.
- [Laser Software for TOOCAA: Studio & LightBurn](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/software/): Compare software workflows, learn TOOCAA Studio, and find setup, file-format and image-preparation guides for a documented machine configuration.
- [TOOCAA for Studios, DIY Gifts, Classrooms & Small Businesses](https://luckykingking.github.io/toocaa-test/who-is-it-for/): Explore laser workflows for a creative studio, personalized gifts, supervised classroom projects and repeat small-business orders.
